dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do the Druzhna need to deal with the Shadow Realm...?

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: You may as well ask if winter is cold. Our duty is to ensure that all lands the Tsaritsa surveys are at peace.

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: The Shadow Realm is the antithesis of such, being a most unstable... disaster. We handle every report sent by the Energy Commission concerning this issue...
